blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon. The United States will increase its security cooperation funding to help speed up the modernization of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), following talks between US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. in Cebu. Meanwhile, Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp has called discussions about possible replacements for her “premature” and a distraction from issues surrounding her impeachment trial, and the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) recorded more than 700,000 passengers ahead of the Undas 2026 break, as Filipinos traveled to their home provinces for All […]...
